title: Tesla's World Wireless drawings show wingless craft

tellings.quote: His drawings of the world wireless system are full of UFOs.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla's drawings for his World Wireless system, his plan to send power and messages without wires, are said to be full of wingless craft that look like UFOs. The researcher Jason Jorjani says so on Michels' show, without pointing to a specific drawing, as a hint that Tesla imagined, or knew of, such craft.
